description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'MessagesApiController' for handling API endpoints related to project messages, comments, and mailing within a larger web application. It includes methods for listing comments, adding/deleting comments, listing messages, and managing project mailing operations, with permission checks and event dispatching.

classes.name: MessagesApiController
classes.description: Controller class managing API endpoints for project messages and comments, including listing, adding, and deleting comments/messages, as well as mailing operations.

methods.name: commentsAction
methods.description: Lists comments for a specific project after permission check.

methods.name: addCommentAction
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a project thread, with permission validation and event dispatching.

methods.name: deleteCommentAction
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment after permission validation.

methods.name: messagesAction
methods.description: Lists all messages for a project, formatted as HTML.

methods.name: userMessagesAction
methods.description: Lists messages specific to a user within a project, including email and read statistics.

methods.name: addMessageAction
methods.description: Adds a project-level message, creating a conversation thread, with recipient management and event dispatching.

methods.name: projectMailingAction
methods.description: Retrieves mailing statistics and message list for a project, with filters for active mailings.
